parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The ID of the basic GA instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1 to 50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region to which the basic GA instance belongs. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the basic GA instance belongs.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
The state of the basic GA instance. Valid values:

*   **init**: The basic GA instance is being initialized.
*   **active**: The basic GA instance is available.
*   **configuring**: The basic GA instance is being configured.
*   **binding**: The basic GA instance is being associated.
*   **unbinding**: The basic GA instance is being disassociated.
*   **deleting**: The basic GA instance is being deleted.
*   **finacialLocked**: The basic GA instance is locked due to overdue payments.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags of the GA instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga list-basic-accelerators --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --accelerator-id ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000 --state active --resource-group-id rg-aekzrnd67gq0000 --tag Value=Valuetest Key=Keytest --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ga ListBasicAccelerators --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key Keytest --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzrnd67gq0000' --PageNumber 1 --State active --Tag.1.Value Valuetest --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AcceleratorId 'ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000'
